paper.title_en: Collinear Fragmentation Functions at NNLO and Constraints on the Proton PDFs
paper.abstract_en: We present the first global analysis of fragmentation functions for charged pions and kaons performed at full next-to-next-to-leading order (NNLO) in QCD. The analysis incorporates comprehensive world data from both single-inclusive electron-positron annihilation and semi-inclusive deep-inelastic scattering. We have tested collinear factorization with low-momentum-transfer data. Furthermore, we investigate how current hadron production data constrains parton distribution functions (PDFs), revealing a preference for reduced asymmetry in strange (anti-)quark PDFs as compared to NNLO PDFs derived from inclusive data analyses.
